bodyHtml:
Join us for the next Knowledge Portal Network webinar:
🧬 Large-Scale Genomics and Proteomics to Study Diabetes and Cardiometabolic Diseases
📆 Thursday, September 24th, 2026
⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET
🎙️ Featured speaker: Satoshi Yoshiji, MD, PhD–Assistant Professor, McGill University & Visiting Scholar, Broad Institute

Topics we will cover:

  1. A brief primer on large-scale biobanks with genomic and proteomic data 
  2. How these data can be used to understand disease biology and nominate candidate effector genes for diabetes and cardiometabolic diseases
  3. How data from the Knowledge Portal can support such research

💻 Register for the event
